name: ALID by Dario Cositore
author: dariocositore91

sections.description:
Turn your contact form into a diagnosis.

ALID is a short diagnostic you embed on your site. A visitor describes what’s breaking in their own words and gets a clear written readout on the spot: what’s going on, a fix path, and how you can help. You get the lead with tier, offer, and full context before the first call.

No code to copy. No snippets to paste. No theme editing.

Key features

  • One-click install. Install, activate, paste your key, done. The widget appears on every page.
  • Two modes. Launcher (a floating button that opens a panel) or Inline (embeds directly in the page content).
  • Page targeting. Show on all pages, show only on specific pages, or exclude specific pages by slug.
  • Mobile hide. Hide the widget on mobile devices.
  • Preconnect hint. Faster widget loading via browser preconnect.
  • Enable/disable toggle. Turn the widget off without deactivating the plugin.
  • Test connection. Verify your key works with one click.
  • Shortcode. Use [alid] in any post or page to embed the widget exactly where you want it.
  • Async loading. The widget loads after the page renders. No performance impact.
  • Branded admin. The settings page uses ALID’s own design, not generic WordPress forms.

What your visitors see

A short diagnostic flow: the visitor describes their problem, gets a written diagnosis with a fix path, and can share the readout as a link. You get the lead with full context in your console before the first call.

Third-party services

The widget connects to the ALID service at dariocositore.com to fetch configuration and process diagnostics. No data is sent until a visitor starts a diagnostic. See the privacy policy and DPA for details.

Security

The plugin does not store any visitor data. It injects a single script tag. All diagnostic data is processed by the ALID service under its own privacy policy. The plugin code is open source (GPL v2) and contains no tracking, no analytics, and no external calls except the widget script and the optional test-connection check.

Commercial plugin

This plugin is free but connects to the ALID service, which has paid plans starting at $19/month. The plugin itself has no paid features or upsells. View pricing
sections.installation:
1. Install using the WordPress built-in Plugin installer, or extract the zip file and drop the contents in the wp-content/plugins/ directory of your WordPress installation.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > ALID Widget and enter your widget key.
  4. You can find your widget key in your ALID console under Install.

For detailed instructions, see the install guide.
sections.faq:
Where do I get my widget key?

Sign up at https://dariocositore.com/tools/ai-lead-intake-diagnostic/ and find your key in the console under Install.

Does this slow down my site?

No. The widget loads asynchronously and only after the page has rendered. It does not block page load.

Can I control where the widget appears?

Yes. Use the Mode setting to choose between a floating launcher button or an inline embed. Use the Exclude pages field to hide it on specific pages. You can also use the [alid] shortcode to place it exactly where you want in a post or page.

How do I test if my key works?

Click the “Test connection” button on the settings page. It pings the ALID API and shows whether your key is valid.

Is this free?

The plugin is free and open source (GPL v2). ALID itself has a free Starter plan (14 days, 10 runs, no card) and paid plans starting at $19/month.

What is the shortcode?

Use [alid] in any post or page to embed the widget inline. You can specify a mode: [alid mode=”inline”] or [alid mode=”launcher”].

What data does the plugin collect?

None. The plugin injects a script tag. All data is processed by the ALID service. See the privacy policy for details.

Does it work with caching plugins?

Yes. The widget loads via an async script tag, which is compatible with all major caching plugins (WP Rocket, W3 Total Cache, LiteSpeed Cache, etc.).### How do I become a contributor?

If you want to contribute or report an issue, contact support@dariocositore.com.
